description: This file defines a mock class `StubWiFi` for testing the `WiFiManager` interface within the `WPEFramework::Plugin` namespace. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods and overrides several virtual functions from `WiFiManager`. The class includes methods to handle WiFi events and retrieve information, likely used in unit testing scenarios for WiFi management.
